exposure: mode of birth (cesarean vs vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 399 mothers who delivered at Mekelle public hospitals in Ethiopia and were interviewed in their immediate postpartum period.
finding: The prevalence of family planning uptake in the immediate postpartum period was 17.8%, with counseling being the most significant factor influencing modern contraception uptake.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth by cesarean delivery were twice as likely to use family planning compared to those who delivered vaginally.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from April 1 to July 31, 2022, during the immediate postpartum period.
